name: Refund Request confirmation
description: Refund Request confirmation Notification: confirms to the buyer that their Refund Request was raised and is under review. Sent by Cadence itself, so no actor. Cadence renders the row text, with no link; the template is only a fallback, and Knock requires its action_url.

template.markdown_body: Your refund request for **{{ courseTitle }}** is under review.
